ProjectId.description: Identifies a project: one Git repository Nodal manages units for.

description:
The range of ports one project hands out from.

A project is given a block the first time it needs a port, and keeps it. Blocks are
equal in length and do not overlap, so a port number says which project holds it.

first.description: The lowest port in the block.

last.description: The highest port in the block.

project_id.description: The project the block belongs to.

title: PortBlock
